% table-unruled — a table with no rules, recognizable only by its alignment.
%
% table.tex is ruled on every edge, so its grid can be read from the strokes. Here
% there are none: three columns of text and right-aligned numbers held apart by
% white space alone, which is how most reports set a small table. The numbers are
% right-aligned so the column edges differ between the text and the figures.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tabular}{llr}
Station & Region & Rainfall \\
Ashford & South & 712 \\
Brampton & North & 1048 \\
Carlisle & North & 893 \\
\end{tabular}
\end{document}
